# anthropic_compliance_effective_settings (Data Source)

Reads the settings actually in force for one linked organization (retention, redaction, SSO provisioning mode, IP allowlist, session duration, capability toggles) after policy and dependency rules are applied. Use it to attest a security baseline in policy checks.

~> The parent organization itself is not a valid target and returns not found. A setting that is missing from the response is not controllable by the organization's administrators; it does not mean the setting is off. Requires `compliance_api_key` (a Compliance Access Key) or an `enterprise_api_key` carrying the `read:compliance_org_data` scope; Admin API keys are rejected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_compliance_effective_settings" "example" {
  organization_uuid = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
}

# Attest the security baseline: fail the plan if content redaction is off.
check "content_redaction" {
  assert {
    condition     = jsondecode(lookup(data.anthropic_compliance_effective_settings.example.settings_map, "content_redaction_enabled", "false"))
    error_message = "Content redaction must be enabled."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_uuid` (String) UUID of a linked organization (not the parent).

### Read-Only

- `api_keys` (Attributes List) Every Compliance Access Key configured for the parent organization (secrets are never returned). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_keys))
- `organization_id` (String) Organization UUID echoed by the API.
- `settings` (Attributes List) Typed setting rows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))
- `settings_map` (Map of String) The same rows keyed by setting name; values are compact JSON strings.

<a id="nestedatt--api_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `api_keys`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `created_by_id` (String) Id of the creating user; may be null.
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry timestamp; null when the key does not expire.
- `id` (String) Key id.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the key is active.
- `name` (String) Key name.
- `scopes` (List of String) Scopes carried by the key.


<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Setting name, for example `content_redaction_enabled`.
- `type` (String) `boolean`, `integer`, `string_list`, `provisioning_mode` or `data_retention`.
- `value_json` (String) The value as compact JSON (for example `true`, `28800`, `["10.0.0.0/8"]`). Decode with `jsondecode`.
